object_types.name: Student
object_types.definition: A person who enrolls in course offerings.

object_types.name: Course

object_types.name: CourseOffering

ambiguities.description: It is unclear whether 'enrolled in' (line 31) refers to a separate Enrollment relationship distinct from the grade-bearing fact, or whether enrollment and grading are the same fact type. The transcript says a student 'was enrolled in' an offering and then 'receives a letter grade' -- this may imply an Enrollment concept with its own lifecycle (e.g., enrolled but not yet graded) that is not fully described. Should Enrollment be modeled as a distinct objectified entity separate from the grade fact, potentially with a status like 'in progress' before grading?
